title: Recent Workplace Safety Offences and Incidence of Repeat Offenders
what_it_is: Recent Workplace Safety Offences and Incidence of Repeat Offenders

sections.label: MOM enforcement penalties on companies
sections.summary: MOM issued 12 stop-work orders, over 200 composition fines and close to 1,600 notices to 558 companies, over half previously penalised for WSH offences.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MOM issued a total of 12 stop-work orders (SWO), over 200 composition fines and close to 1,600 notices of non-compliances to 558 companies in the Construction, Manufacturing, Transportation and Storage and Accommodation, and Food Services sectors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Despite the Heightened Safety Period and the repeated calls by the Ministry, slightly more than half of the 558 companies had received penalties for workplace safety and health (WSH) offences previously.

sections.label: Director charged under WSH Act
sections.summary: A director of Thyme Food & Services was charged under section 48 of the WSH Act for failure to prevent the occupier's offence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: One is the director of Thyme Food & Services who was charged under section 48 of the WSH Act for failure to prevent the offence of the occupier.

sections.label: StartSAFE company sign-ups
sections.summary: More than 140 companies signed up for StartSAFE since September and October this year, during the heightened safety period.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Specific to StartSAFE, I agree with the Member that beyond just enforcement and penalties, it is also important for us to inculcate that culture and mindset of workplace safety among leaders and businesses.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, if we look at StartSAFE, we have brought in more than 140 companies, in fact, that have signed up since September and October this year since we started the heightened safety period.

sections.label: Fatal accident rates before and after
sections.summary: Before 1 September there were about 4.5 fatal accidents per month on average, and about two fatalities per month after the heightened safety alert.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Prior to 1 September, we were having about 4.5 fatal accidents per month, on average.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: After the heightened safety alert was implemented, we have about two fatalities per month.

sections.label: Auditors and debarment of companies
sections.summary: More than 30 companies had to engage external auditors after stop-work orders, and Le Fong Building Service and Green Cycling were debarred from employing new foreign workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: To date, more than 30 companies were also required to engage external auditors to conduct a thorough review of the WSH processes following the issuance of stop-work orders during the heightened safety period.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, in addition, two companies Le Fong Building Service and Green Cycling were debarred from employing new foreign workers for up to three months and their CEOs had to personally account to MOM to take responsibility for rectifications.

sections.label: Decision deferred until March
sections.summary: The decision will be made after March next year once the total outcome of the whole period is seen.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Let us wait till March next year and then we will decide after we see the total outcome of the whole period.
